chapter: The 1940s: small groups, Teddy Wilson and Ethel Waters
title: Billy Butler makes him contractor for Ethel Waters' Blue Holiday
summary: Billy Butler asked Thomas to run the pit band for Ethel Waters' show Blue Holiday, handling payroll and time. Thomas first resisted, wanting only to play, but Babe and Butler talked him into it.
